ctx.x: So I messed around Newark, New Jersey until I kept studying with a man named Emory Lucas, music.

he says, well, Jack, why don't you go up to the Big Apple and see a man named Professor Jackson, so I says okay, and I went up there and Professor Jackson, couldn't hardly hold the clarinet and so they had another fellow named Joe Crump and Joe Crump had a whole set of gold teeth and had diamonds on each side and this little funny looking place, so he says well, can you play anything so I played the melody and he said, that's nice, so he said can you come to work, and so Jackson said yes, so then come to work…

Now, that night people, we're playing and it seemed like people started arguing out in the street on the other side of town and they come up there and fight it out and cut it up, so see, Joe couldn't read so I said Joe, now that's F, what do you mean, oh, yes, and right across the street Joe had his bordello right across the street -- well, I won't give you the name of the street -- it was something there --
